title: The role of 1,4-palladium migration in C(sp3)–H functionalization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,40103-40128
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05835J, Review Article

Mohammad Sadegh Karimtabar, Yasin Mohammadkhani Kalooei, Fatemeh Doraghi, Mohammad Mahdavi, Parviz Rashidi Ranjbar
C(sp3)–H activation is a major area in organic synthesis. Palladium's versatility makes it essential for C–H activation. We explored 1,4-palladium migration as a common metal migration pathway in C(sp3)–H functionalization.
